result.topic_en: A natural-philosophy passage (not mathematics) arguing that the purposiveness of organic life on Earth must be explained by a unified, progressing thought-process in the Earth, i.e. an 'Erdseele' (earth-soul), with reference to F.'s (presumably Fechner's) view of plants.
